question: If I control no creatures, can I still choose to blight to pay Auntie Ool's ward cost?

expected.shortAnswer: No: if you cannot put -1/-1 counters on any creature you control, you cannot choose to blight.
expected.answer: If you can't place -1/-1 counters on any creatures you control (probably because you control no creatures), you can't choose to blight.
